summary: Tested sponsor APIs/UI, public map, admin alert flow, sponsor CRUD/RBAC, admin bins/users/refill/XLSX regressions, and required auth security checks. Core requested features work, but 3 of 15 backend tests fail (90% boundary, wildcard credentialed CORS, no brute-force lockout). Frontend desktop flows pass; mobile navigation/overflow and a misleading alert toast remain.

critical.issue: No brute-force lockout: six consecutive invalid admin logins all return 401; the sixth should be rate-limited/locked with 429 after five failures.
Credentialed CORS allows an arbitrary Origin and returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * together with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true instead of an explicit allowlist.

minor.issue: A bin at exactly 90.0% is alerted even though the requirement and Admin label say over/exceeds 90%; reproduced with PZ-010 and restored its original document afterward.

ui_bugs.issue: At 390px, nav-map and nav-sponsors are hidden and there is no mobile menu, so the new public pages are not discoverable from navigation.
Mobile header is 416px wide in a 390px viewport; the Register button ends at x=415.84 and is clipped, causing horizontal overflow.

integration_issues.issue: When the API returns alerted=[] and skipped_already_alerted=['PZ-006'], the UI says 'No bins over 90% right now. All calm.' even though a 91% bin exists and was only skipped because it was already alerted.

issues: No compact/hamburger navigation for Map and Sponsors below the md breakpoint.
Brand chip plus auth controls exceed viewport width and clip the Register CTA.

action_items: Change alert threshold logic so exactly 90% is not treated as over 90% (use <= in the skip condition, or clarify requirement/UI if >=90 is intended).
Add failed-login tracking/rate limiting and return 429 after five failed attempts.
Configure explicit allowed CORS origins; do not combine wildcard origin with credentialed requests.
Make the Run Alerts toast distinguish skipped/already-alerted bins from truly having no bins over 90%.
Add mobile navigation for Live Map and Sponsors and make header controls fit within 390px.
Only persist last_alert_at when at least one production email send succeeds, or persist failure state and support retry.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 423 uses fill_percent < 90, which includes exactly 90 despite the >90 contract.
server.py lines 437-440 set last_alert_at even if every send_email result is failed, which would suppress retries after a production email outage.
server.py CORS middleware uses CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True; use an explicit environment-provided origin list.
Login has no attempt counter, cooldown, or rate limiter.
Admin.jsx derives the alert toast only from alerted.length and ignores skipped_already_alerted, producing a false all-clear.
PublicMap.jsx and Sponsors.jsx silently swallow API failures and provide no loading/error state, leaving an unexplained empty page on backend failure.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary sponsor petzzy-manage and deleted it; temporarily set PZ-010 to 90% for boundary testing and restored the original document. Alert checks updated alert timestamps as designed; refill regression reset PZ-001 to 5% fill and 20 kg pellets.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Desktop /map renders 10 markers and 10 public-bin cards; /sponsors renders 3 cards; Ather detail renders 3 bins and 4 impact cards. Admin alerts, tabs, XLSX, and refill integrations pass. Auth cookie is HttpOnly+Secure, bcrypt starts with $2b$, and seed_admin code updates a changed password. Re-test the three backend failures plus mobile navbar and skipped-alert toast after fixes.
rca_of_the_issue: Threshold mismatch is an incorrect comparison (< instead of <=). The false alert toast ignores skipped_already_alerted. Mobile defects come from hidden md:flex nav without a mobile alternative and a fixed-content header that exceeds 390px. Auth security failures stem from wildcard CORS configuration and absent failed-login state/rate limiting.
